name: strict-ts-monorepo
description: Make TypeScript and JavaScript as safe as Rust, without changing language.

scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/playground && node packages/playground/scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p packages/language-service && node packages/language-service/scripts/build.mjs && node packages/vscode/scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check: node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/core && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/std && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/cli && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/playground && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/language-service && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/wrap && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/codemod && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/derive && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/oxlint-plugin && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p packages/probe && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p examples/invoice/strict && node packages/derive/dist/main.js examples/invoice/derived/invoice.ts --check && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p examples/invoice/derived && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p examples/report/strict && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p examples/cart/strict && node packages/cli/dist/main.js --strict-baseline -p examples/transfer/strict
scripts.probe: rm -rf .strict-ts-probe && STRICT_TS_PROBE=1 vitest run && node packages/probe/dist/main.js report
